external.react-ui: You are building a screen and need a component, a token or a theme. It is the design system; library packages here must not import it, so only apps and products take it.

runtimePaths.credential: `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` in the environment. `assertAuthEnvOk` refuses to start without it, and strips `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` unless `allowApiKeyBilling` is set. This is `runAgent`'s default harness.
runtimePaths.smoke: A one-turn `runAgent` call with `maxTurns: 1` and a small `maxBudgetUsd`; an `auth_misconfigured` failure means the token is missing.

runtimePaths.credential: The Claude Code CLI's own keychain login. No OAuth token; `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is stripped unless `allowApiKeyBilling` is set. One turn only: tools, MCP, hooks and resume throw a `TypeError` before spawn. Not yet a `HarnessAdapter`, so `dispatchHarnessRun` and the durable dispatcher cannot use it.
runtimePaths.smoke: A one-turn `runAgent({ harness: "claude-print", model: "sonnet", prompt, outputSchema, maxTurns: 1, maxBudgetUsd: 0.5 })`; a logged-out CLI returns `auth_misconfigured`.

runtimePaths.credential: A cached `codex login` (ChatGPT). API-key variables are stripped from the child. checkCodexAvailable resolves the installed CLI, requires >=0.162.1 and checks required command capabilities; availability is not a login or permission certificate.

`agentRunner` calls `runAgent`, so it needs `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, or only the CLI login when its `defaults` set `harness: "claude-print"`. `durableHarnessRunner` needs whatever its dispatcher's adapter needs. `inlineRunner` needs nothing; `idempotentRunner` wraps another runner.
runtimePaths.smoke: Run the workflow once with `inlineRunner` to prove the steps, then swap in the model runner.

runtimePaths.credential: No credential in the package. It never calls a model, a shell or git itself; every effect is a port the host supplies, so the host's ports carry whatever the implementer agent and the evaluator need (see the `agent` paths above).
runtimePaths.smoke: `pnpm vitest run packages/autoresearch` runs the whole recipe on fake ports over a local fixture repo and bare remote, at $0 and with no model call.

runtimePaths.path: Style tool runners: ESLint, ruff, and the Python audit tools
runtimePaths.credential: No credential. ESLint runs through `npx` and needs its plugins installed. ruff, `lint-imports`, vulture, pydoclint and pyright must be on PATH; an absent Python audit tool returns a warning naming its `pip install`, never a throw.
runtimePaths.smoke: `ruff --version` and `npx eslint --version` in the target repo.

runtimePaths.credential: No credential. `local` needs the optional `@huggingface/transformers` peer; `ollama` needs a reachable Ollama. `fallbackToHash: true` keeps a run alive with neither.
runtimePaths.smoke: `createEmbedder({ backend: "ollama" }, { fallbackToHash: true, onFallback: console.warn })`; a warning means the hash fallback took over.

runtimePaths.path: agent-chat CLI: roster read, reviewer spawn, resume (`agent ls --json`, `agent spawn <name> <profile> --brief-stdin`, `agent resume <name> --message <text>`)
runtimePaths.credential: No credential in the caller. The agent-chat broker starts `claude` under its own login or the profile's config dir. The CLI reaches the broker over its 0600 unix socket as the same OS user, so a broker must be running; set `AGENT_CHAT_NO_AUTOSTART=1` to fail instead of starting one. A spawn runs in the caller's cwd.
runtimePaths.smoke: `AGENT_CHAT_NO_AUTOSTART=1 agent-chat agent ls --json` prints a JSON array (about 6.5 s with 700 rows, so do not call it on a hot path). Then `printf 'Reply with the word ok and stop.' | agent-chat agent spawn <name> <profile> --brief-stdin`; the roster row ends with `presence: "exited"`, a non-empty `sessionId` and `transcriptExists: true`. Resume, smoke-tested 2026-10-06: once that row has exited, `agent-chat agent resume <name> --message <text>` runs a new turn in the same session; `sessionId` is the same before and after, and both replies are in one transcript.

knownGaps.title: No auth-mode switch (oauth-token, cli-login, api-key) or `appendSystemPrompt` on agent runs
No config-dir auth source for headless Claude runs
No `claude -p` adapter with a pinned conversation id
No conversation control core (agent-thread package not built)
No byte-budget head and tail truncator for tool output
No driver-neutral SQLite seam; packages call better-sqlite3 directly
`CacheBlobTable` has no delete, eviction or TTL
No byte-range markdown and JSON chunker for embeddings
No typo recovery when fused results are empty
No channel-neutral inbound message type; Telegram and BlueBubbles inbound are still separate shapes
No static dataset encoder, `./export` writer or static source
`computeLcomMetrics` and cognitive complexity are not exported from the root
`generateEslintExport` emits a config without plugins, parser or files
No shared subprocess-with-deadline runner, git wrapper or repo-root resolver; each repo carries its own copies (package not built)
Some package.json descriptions are stale, and they feed this catalog
